title: Fix CodeLlama tokenizer dropping leading whitespace on decode

target.summary: Replacing the Metaspace pre-tokenizer with Prepend and Replace normalizers breaks encoding for existing checkpoints. The prepend normalizer modifies special tokens marked with normalized=True so they no longer match, and it prepends a metaspace after every special token chunk, altering output token IDs.
